curve_catalog._doc: PB30 P82 centreline (℄ Curve Data) curves, R and T as read from the scan and recorded in the project notes (horizontal-curves memory, 2026-09-23). Shellfish T=82.35 is the plat's own value (internally 0.084 off -- a plat discrepancy, kept as printed). A read curve is 'right' if R is within 1% of a catalog R (and T within 1% when read), else 'wrong'.
